newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady despite crude rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady despite crude rally.

text.p: NWE gasoline, pressured slightly by a rise in U.S. gasoline inventories, ended steady despite a sharp rally in Brent crude oil, traders said on Wednesday.
But heavy buying from a Scandanavian producer, believed to have bought around 10,000 tonnes of Eurograde barges today, supported prices, they said.

Further stockbuilding in Britain ahead of the U.K. government's budget on November 26 aided prices, but some traders contined to warn that the market could drop sharply later this month as those supplies are resold.
